findings.text: Net revenue fell by 58,460 USD from 309,620 to 251,160 over the six‑month period.

Fixes to fulfilment take weeks to show in satisfaction and repeat orders.
Added temporary support capacity costs money before the backlog falls.

5-mission.note: Illustrative link: the synthetic store's refund problem is represented by JARVIS's canonical duplicate-charge order #48291. They are separate synthetic records.

request.message: I was charged twice for order #48291.

sections.text: A duplicate charge is two or more successful payments on the same order with identical amount and currency, made within the duplicate window.
A verified duplicate may be refunded automatically below the authority threshold.
After the refund the order must remain paid exactly once in full.
No autonomous refund if any evidence conflicts, or if the charge was already refunded.

proposal.rationale: Both transactions are successful, same amount and currency, on the same order, within the duplicate window. The order is overpaid by exactly one charge. No conflicts or prior refunds. Refund the later charge and keep the earlier one to satisfy the policy.
